audit_methodology.scope_caveat: Labels reflect automated rule-plus-author structured verification against verbatim CPSC JSON text. Independent double-blind multi-coder human adjudication and matched CPSC compliance progress reports remain required to extend from notice-level written duties to realized operational fulfillment rates.

9924.audit_adjudication_note: Benchmark edge case (Jugader 24-199): optional alternative 'photo of the cable and the trolley OR their online purchase order number' for free repair kit; correctly excluded from mandatory photo destruction.

10148.audit_adjudication_note: Benchmark edge case (UVIPC 25-122): 'submit proof of destruction to obtain a full refund' with ZERO literal photo wording; correctly captured by destruction_proof_without_photo=1 and physically_disabled=1.

10311.audit_adjudication_note: Benchmark edge case (Anker 25-338, 1.158M units): multi-channel online ('Anker, Amazon, Newegg and Ebay'), permanent marking + photo + disposal confirmation (not physically disabled); full-notice HHW warning=1.

10895.audit_adjudication_note: Benchmark edge case (OCOOPA 26-659, 1.500M units): multi-channel online ('Amazon.com, Ocoopa.com, Ocoopa.net and Walmart.com'), permanent marking + photo + explicit HHW prohibition of trash/curbside bins.

10317.audit_adjudication_note: Benchmark edge case (TADAKAZU 25-345): strict Amazon-exclusive ('Exclusively on Amazon'), physical cutting + photo; sole standalone 'FBA' token appears inside product model-name suffix, explicit_fba=0.
